thag2.1:1.1: niṭṭhito Ekanipāto. DUKANIPĀTO. N' atthi koci bhavo nicco saṃkhārā vāpi sassatā, uppajjanti ca te khandhā cavanti aparāparaṃ. || ||
thag2.1:2.1: etaṃ ādīnavaṃ ñatvā bhaven' amhi anatthiko, nissaṭo sabbakāmehi, patto me āsavakkhayo 'ti. || || itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Uttaro thero gāthāyo abhāsitthā 'ti.
